Class Employee

java.lang.Object
frontend.Employee
All Implemented Interfaces:
ActionListener, EventListener
public class Employee extends Object implements ActionListener
The employee (cashier) view: category buttons along the top, the menu items of the chosen category in the middle, and the shopping cart with the running total on the right. Clicking an item adds it to the cart. Every button sends its click to actionPerformed, which uses the button's action command ("Category - name", "Item - id", "Submit Order" or "Close") to decide what to do.
